claim_verdicts.evidence: tofu plan by default: "Reads the current state of any already-existing remote objects to make sure that the OpenTofu state is up-to-date." / "Compares the current configuration to the prior state and noting any differences." Round 2: section 4 now says "works from one folder's files and that folder's state only, and checks only the real objects that state records", matching the claim.

"Workspaces in the OpenTofu CLI refer to separate instances of state data inside the same OpenTofu working directory." "Every initialized working directory starts with one workspace named default." select: "The tofu workspace select command is used to choose a different workspace to use for further operations." Usage: "tofu workspace select NAME [DIR]".

"CLI workspaces within a working directory use the same backend"; remote workspaces "are stored directly in the configured backend." Example count = "${terraform.workspace == "default" ? 5 : 1}". Round 3: section 4 now reads "differ only through values chosen per workspace, such as variable values. They also share the folder's `backend.tf`, the file that says where state is kept." Matches the docs.

terraform_remote_state "uses the latest state snapshot from a specified state backend to retrieve the root module output values"; example reference data.terraform_remote_state.vpc.outputs.subnet_id. Read-only: data sources page, "data resources cause OpenTofu only to read objects".

Provider configuration arguments "can only refer to values that are known before the configuration is applied." "This means you can safely reference input variables, but not attributes exported by resources". Execution: outputs/stage-3/scripts/devops/tofu-environments.txt lines 11-17 show endpoint and certificates as (known after apply).
